$comment: Version contract for the Azure Landing Zone Factory. This file is read by site/ (stamped into every exported lz-config.json), by scaffold-copy (written into the generated repository root), and by the generated repo's upgrade-check workflow (diffed against the factory's published version to open an upgrade PR). Bump factoryVersion on any change to the schema, templates, or scripts.

contracts.$comment: Must match the const value of schemaVersion in factory/schema/lz-config.schema.json. The renderer refuses any config whose schemaVersion it does not implement.

landingZone.$comment: Version of the emitted landing-zone content (templates + workflows + docs). Tracked separately from factoryVersion so tooling-only changes do not force customer-repo upgrades.
landingZone.$layersComment: Layers the template corpus can actually emit. Guard G21 reads this list and refuses to render a configuration selecting anything absent from it. workloads-nonprod is implemented; platform-identity remains deliberately absent because no Terraform exists for it.

modules.$comment: Version and implementation status of each Terraform module in the template corpus. status=scaffold means the module has no real resources yet; the renderer REFUSES to emit a configuration that enables a scaffold module, rather than producing a silent no-op. Source of truth for these statuses is TODO.md.

compatibility.$comment: Ordered list of prior factoryVersions this release can upgrade a generated repo from. Only N-1 upgrades are supported (assumption A4).

releaseGates.$comment: v1.0.0 cannot be declared until every gate below is true. Gate 2 reflects risk OR2: as of 2026-07-24 the pipeline has no recorded successful run (TODO.md), so the factory must not ship on an unproven deployment path.
